cells.name: E-10 slider own release
cells.line: Tab-engaged scale ×1.000 < ×1.03: the keyboard does not engage this slider, so the release has no step to film (the hand-off and Escape cells read NOT DRIVEN)

cells.name: E-10 slider escape release
cells.line: NOT DRIVEN: the slider was not keyboard-engaged at the Escape (×1.000 < ×1.03)

cells.name: E-10 slider re-render landing
cells.line: a sibling inserted during the hold, then release: the root's largest one-frame move per 16.7 ms 0.0 px (without the insert 0.0 px; bound ≤ that + 1 px)

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off drop
cells.line: NOT DRIVEN: A was not engaged at the Tab (×1.000, veil 0.00)

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off singleton fwd
cells.line: 90 frames: engaged roots per frame max 1, 0 frame(s) with none · first frame A engaged true, B false · last frame B engaged true, A false (bound: at most one engaged on every frame, the incoming one at the end; selector [data-engaged])

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off veil
cells.line: no veil up before the Tab (0.00): this route veils no keyboard engagement

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off rev
cells.line: NOT DRIVEN: B was not engaged at the Shift+Tab (×1.000, veil 0.00)

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off singleton rev
cells.line: 89 frames: engaged roots per frame max 1, 0 frame(s) with none · first frame B engaged true, A false · last frame A engaged true, B false (bound: at most one engaged on every frame, the incoming one at the end; selector [data-engaged])
